parse_xml_with_comments: parse an XML file preserving comments using a version-aware ElementTree parser
get_xml_str: serialize an ElementTree or Element node to a string with optional pretty formatting
merge_xmls: merge a donor XML file into a receiver XML file at a specified node
merge_xmls_to_tree: merge two XML files and return the combined result as an ElementTree object
merge_xmls_to_string: merge two XML files and return the combined result as a formatted string
